final_message:
Configured the DNS hierarchy with 31 authoritative zones and 30 delegations. Each parent has matching glue for its child name servers. PC32 (`10.15.8.14`) is the recursive resolver, and all 40 PCs point to it. The requested service and MX records are included; the topology, addresses, and routes were preserved.

The configuration and example queries are documented in [DNS-README.md](/private/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-qhseat7k/lab/DNS-README.md).

Structural checks passed for the zone count, delegations, glue, resolver settings, and startup script syntax. I could not run a live DNS test: BIND utilities are unavailable in this environment, and access to the Docker daemon is denied. The lab image must provide BIND 9’s `named` executable.
